stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key ML/AI tags including 'transformers', 'llama', and 'text-generation'.
The context suggests this is a benchmark or model showcase rather than a major breakthrough announcement.

stories.title: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Google DeepMind has released Gemini Robotics 2, a new AI model for robotics.
The key advancement is the model's capability to control the entire body of humanoid robots, not just the upper body.
This development signifies a major step toward more complex, whole-body autonomous robotic operation.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation and conversational AI pipelines.
The associated tags indicate its relevance to transformers and safetensors frameworks.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model from Meta.
It is featured on Hugging Face Benchmarks, indicating community interest and performance tracking.
The model is categorized under text-generation and utilizes standard ML frameworks like transformers.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance gain is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to a 90% speed increase, as validated by the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements translate to higher quality model responses.
The updated engine also delivers faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for enhanced performance.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon, optimizing AI workloads on Apple hardware.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, indicating ongoing development.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging apps with local AI coding agents.
The core value proposition is running AI agents entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: Tim Cook hints at iCloud Plus tier for AI power users
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Apple is hinting at a tiered subscription model for its new AI features.
Tim Cook suggested that iCloud Plus may receive upgrades to accommodate high AI usage.
This indicates Apple plans to monetize the increased demand for Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.

stories.title: Apple’s iPhone and Mac sales keep growing despite RAM shortages
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Apple reported significant sales growth in Q3, with iPhone sales jumping 22% to $54.25 billion.
Mac sales also saw a strong increase of 29%, contributing to overall revenue reaching $109.4 billion.
This growth occurred despite ongoing global memory shortages affecting the device manufacturing industry.

stories.title: Quantum computers outperform classical ones, with results you can trust
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: The article addresses the fundamental challenge of verifying quantum computational results classically.
It discusses three distinct approaches designed to ensure the trustworthiness of quantum outputs.
The news signals progress in the reliability and practical application of quantum computing.

stories.title: Mythos attack on 3rd-round PQC algorithm candidate puts it out of commission
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: A significant vulnerability was discovered in HAWK, a third-round Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithm candidate.
The weakness was exposed by an attack utilizing the Mythos framework.
This discovery effectively removes HAWK from contention in the ongoing PQC standardization process.

stories.title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
stories.author: Arvind Narayanan
bullet_points: The paper addresses the critical, yet unproven, concept of AI agents conducting open-ended AI research.
It critiques existing evaluation methods, noting that current tests are either too narrow or rely on unreliable peer review.
The authors propose a novel methodology to measure progress toward automating AI Research & Development (R&D).

stories.title: APEX-Accounting
stories.author: Bertie Vidgen
bullet_points: Introduction of APEX-Accounting, a new benchmark designed to test frontier AI models on real-world accounting tasks.
The benchmark assesses complex accounting functions such as account reconciliation, expense accrual, and transaction posting.
The private evaluation set consists of 160 expert-authored tasks spanning various accounting systems and document types (spreadsheets, PDFs).

stories.title: APEX-Accounting
stories.author: Bertie Vidgen
bullet_points: Introduction of APEX-Accounting, a new benchmark designed to test frontier models' capabilities in real-world accounting tasks.
The benchmark features a private evaluation set of 160 tasks across 10 simulated 'worlds,' incorporating diverse file types like PDFs and spreadsheets.
The tasks (e.g., reconciling accounts, accruing expenses) were authored and solved by accounting and bookkeeping experts, lending high domain relevance.

stories.title: DenseOn with the LateOn: Fully Open Dense and Late-Interaction Models for Multilingual, Long-Context, and Code Search
stories.author: Amélie Chatelain
bullet_points: Introduces DenseOn with LateOn, an open-source framework for training dense and late-interaction retrieval models.
Addresses the reproducibility gap in state-of-the-art retrieval models by providing an open end-to-end training recipe.
Demonstrates cross-lingual transferability by using English supervision and 'translate-train' across 34 public sources.

stories.title: On-Policy Distillation for LLM Safety: A Routing Approach to Template-Robust Realignment
stories.author: Sheng Wen
bullet_points: Addresses the critical vulnerability of LLMs being poisoned by malicious data during fine-tuning.
Proposes 'On-Policy Distillation' with a routing approach to enhance LLM safety and alignment.
Overcomes limitations of existing safety defenses, such as catastrophic forgetting and reduced effectiveness against adversarial inputs.

stories.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
stories.author: ai2027
bullet_points: Gemini Robotics 2 introduces whole-body intelligence capabilities to robots.
This suggests a significant advancement in embodied AI and robotics.
The news points toward a major step in making robots more autonomous and capable.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings enhanced performance and broader model support.
Integration with llama.cpp improves GGUF model compatibility across various hardware.
The update augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting Apple silicon users.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating local LLM execution.

stories.title: Xbox CEO lays out priorities in memo after major ‘reset’
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma outlined priorities following a major corporate 'reset' involving layoffs and studio spin-offs.
The stated goal is to drive Xbox back toward a state of growth.
Sharma set a target for this turnaround to be achieved by the end of fiscal year 2027.

stories.title: LinkedIn actually adds a ‘seems like AI slop’ button
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: LinkedIn is implementing a new feature allowing users to report content as 'Seems like AI slop'.
This update is part of LinkedIn's broader effort to reduce the prevalence of AI-generated, low-quality content on the platform.
The introduction of this reporting mechanism addresses growing user concerns regarding the quality and authenticity of content on professional networking sites.

stories.title: New MCP specification addresses the main barrier to enterprise adoption
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: A new MCP specification has been released.
This specification aims to overcome a primary obstacle to enterprise adoption.
A new policy for the AI protocol guarantees feature stability against sudden removals.

stories.title: Musk went to “war,” sought jail time for X ad boycotts—but case ends with a whimper
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Elon Musk pursued legal action against advertisers boycotting X.
The legal conflict regarding the ad boycotts ultimately concluded without a major ruling.
Advertisers and X have agreed to reset their business relationship.

stories.title: Who wins and who loses after US bans foreign robots?
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: A potential US government ban on foreign-made robots is the central topic.
The analysis suggests this ban might negatively impact, rather than benefit, the domestic US robotics industry.
The article discusses the complex economic and technological implications of such a trade restriction.

stories.title: The Social Cost of an AI Teammate: How an Artificial Teammate Reshapes Human-Human Communication in Small-Team Decision-Making
stories.author: Spencer JaQuay
bullet_points: Investigates how the integration of conversational AI as a 'teammate' alters human-human communication within small decision-making groups.
Uses a randomized controlled study involving moral-dilemma tasks to analyze sociocognitive communication dynamics.
Employs methods including Group Communication Analysis (GCA), surveys, and lexical analysis to study the impact of AI presence.

stories.title: Improving Item Discoverability in e-Commerce Search via Related Intent Generation
stories.author: Tejaswi Tenneti
bullet_points: Addresses a limitation in traditional e-commerce search by prioritizing recall over strict precision.
Proposes a 'discovery-augmented search' system using intent-conditioned recall expansion.
Aims to improve user satisfaction and commercial outcomes by surfacing related, substitute, and complementary items.

stories.title: OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding
stories.author: Hua Wu
bullet_points: Introduces OmegaUse-OfficeVal, a new benchmark for evaluating LLM agents.
Focuses on long-horizon office-suite tasks, moving beyond simple single-prompt evaluations.
Adds 'economic grounding' to the evaluation, assessing agent performance relative to cost.

stories.title: Cost-Sensitive Conformal Prediction and Human-in-the-Loop Abstention for Imbalanced High-Stakes Decision Support: A Multi-Domain Benchmark
stories.author: Shyamal Lakhanpal
bullet_points: Addresses a critical flaw in standard Conformal Prediction (CP) when applied to high-stakes, imbalanced datasets.
Demonstrates that standard CP severely under-covers rare, costly minority classes (e.g., fraud, critical medical events).
Proposes a solution involving Cost-Sensitive CP and Human-in-the-Loop Abstention for robust uncertainty quantification.

stories.title: DLAM: Distributional Latent Actions with Temporal Constraints
stories.author: Zhiheng Ma
bullet_points: The paper addresses the data scarcity issue in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by leveraging abundant action-free video data.
DLAM proposes a method using latent action models to extract priors from videos, overcoming limitations of purely reconstruction-trained codes.
The research focuses on improving structured latent action models by incorporating temporal constraints to better integrate with robotic action generation.

stories.title: Linguistic Monoculture in LLM-Assisted Language Use
stories.author: Lutz Oettershagen
bullet_points: Widespread reliance on LLMs for text drafting and revision may lead to 'linguistic monoculture'.
This monoculture suggests a potential reduction in population-level variation in linguistic forms.
The research proposes a mathematical framework to model the interaction between authors and LLMs as distributions over linguistic features.

stories.title: Fairness Pruning: Locating Demographic Bias in GLU-MLP Layers via Differential Activations
stories.author: Alfonso Ureña López
bullet_points: Introduces 'Fairness Pruning,' a lightweight method to manage and mitigate demographic bias in Large Language Models (LLMs).
The technique focuses on causal bias localization by identifying neurons that react differently based on demographic attributes.
It utilizes minimally contrastive prompt pairs and inference-time activation capture specifically within GLU architectures.

stories.title: Fully Inductive Cardinality Estimation
stories.author: Maribel Acosta
bullet_points: The research addresses a critical limitation in Knowledge Graph (KG) query optimization: the need for accurate cardinality estimation.
Existing state-of-the-art learned estimators are transductive, meaning they require retraining when the underlying graph changes.
The paper introduces FICE (Fully Inductive Cardinality Estimation) as a novel solution to enable learned estimation in dynamic, real-world triplestores.

stories.title: A Distributed Acoustic Sensing Dataset for Vessel Detection and Localization in Submarine Cable Protection
stories.author: Roel Vanthillo
bullet_points: Introduces the Marlinks-NS DAS dataset for monitoring submarine cables.
Utilizes Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) on optical fibers for wide-area underwater acoustic monitoring.
Addresses critical infrastructure security concerns related to submarine cable damage and sabotage.

stories.title: Semi-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs via Ensemble Consensus
stories.author: Mikkel N. Schmidt
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of data scarcity in molecular sciences, where labeled data is expensive.
It proposes using Semi-Supervised Learning (SSL) to leverage abundant unlabeled molecular data.
The method introduces an ensemble consensus approach to overcome limitations of traditional label-preserving augmentations in molecular graphs.

stories.title: HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks
stories.author: Xiangbo Tian
bullet_points: The paper addresses the limitations of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) in making LLMs perform well across diverse tasks (e.g., HPC vs. factual QA).
It introduces HARGO, a Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization method, to improve LLM behavior post-training.
The research focuses on applying RL to fine-tune LLMs for specialized, complex tasks like data race detection in HPC environments.

stories.title: CACHE-UK: A Stability-Aware Memory Editor for Sequentially Updated Quantized LLMs in Finance
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of maintaining factual accuracy in LLMs deployed in dynamic financial environments.
Introduces CACHE-UK, a memory editor designed to handle sequential updates in quantized LLMs.
Solves the 'quantization stability crisis' where existing memory editing methods fail under 4-bit quantization.

stories.title: Mental World Modeling
stories.author: Yiran Zhao
bullet_points: The research addresses a limitation in current world models, which only predict physical states.
It proposes 'Mental World Modeling' to incorporate hidden human mental states (beliefs, intentions, desires).
The goal is to enable AI agents to predict and execute actions based on what agents *know* and *believe*, not just the physical reality.

stories.title: SpecFirst: Behavioral Specification Elicitation as a First-Class Step in Agent-Based Program Synthesis from Scratch
stories.author: Ahmed E. Hassan
bullet_points: Addresses the significant challenge of program synthesis from scratch, where current LLM agents struggle despite excelling with existing codebases.
Highlights the limitations of existing frameworks that conflate documentation reading, behavioral exploration, and code synthesis into one step.
Introduces 'SpecFirst,' a new methodology that treats behavioral specification elicitation as a distinct, crucial step in the synthesis process.

stories.title: OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding
stories.author: Hua Wu
bullet_points: Introduces OmegaUse-OfficeVal, a new benchmark for evaluating LLM agents.
The benchmark focuses on long-horizon office-suite tasks, moving beyond simple conversational tests.
A key innovation is the inclusion of 'task-level economic grounding' to assess cost-effectiveness.

stories.title: MindForge: Teaching Small Language Models Whole-Life-Cycle Software Engineering via Source-Free Program Synthesis
stories.author: Ahmed E. Hassan
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'MindForge,' a method to teach small language models the entire software engineering lifecycle.
It addresses the significant challenge of 'from-scratch' program synthesis, where current frontier models perform poorly (under 1% resolution on ProgramBench).
The work aims to overcome the lack of scalable training environments necessary for comprehensive software engineering tasks.

stories.title: Linguistic Monoculture in LLM-Assisted Language Use
stories.author: Lutz Oettershagen
bullet_points: Widespread reliance on LLMs for text generation and revision risks creating 'linguistic monoculture'.
This monoculture suggests a reduction in population-level variation in linguistic forms due to shared model influence.
The research proposes a mathematical framework to model the interaction between authors and LLMs as distributions over linguistic features.

stories.title: Setoka: A Benchmark for Hierarchical User Understanding in Personalized Agents over Heterogeneous Data
stories.author: Xuan Zhou
bullet_points: Introduces 'Setoka,' a new benchmark specifically designed for evaluating hierarchical user understanding in personalized AI agents.
Addresses a gap in current memory benchmarks, which only test explicit fact retrieval rather than deeper inference of abstract user characteristics.
Focuses on the challenge of building effective personalized agents that can handle heterogeneous data and infer complex user profiles.

stories.title: I flagged two research papers for fake authors and both were accepted as orals
stories.author: volumes94
bullet_points: A researcher successfully flagged two academic papers for having fake authors.
Both flagged papers were subsequently accepted for oral presentations at a conference.
The story highlights ongoing issues of academic integrity and research misconduct in tech fields.
